snippet.title: Hope in the City XBOX Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Seventeen-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were the worst thing coming for her. Then she came home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. 

Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game played through the eyes of an artist: investigate, turn sketches into evidence, and watch your family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer. Hope in the City comes to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass on November 10, 2026, with XBOX Play Anywhere support.
